metadata.rendererClock: Inner performance.now clock around synchronous band.replace(records). Sparse and jump are single calls. Scroll totals sum 31 calls across 32 stock-controller scroll steps. Excludes correctness checks, dispatch, and layout and paint after the call.
metadata.presentationClock: Stock scale fixture Chromium Element Timing of visible status marker relative to trusted click handler entry. Final cell also hit-tested outside clock.
metadata.order: Fresh Chromium per arm/round. Per round cyclic permutation of arms. Jump first via trusted sparse update and jump clicks; separate new browser context/page/model for overlapping scroll.
metadata.normalizationClock: Every adapter receives the same raw immutable records. The new JSX adapter converts incoming records to owned scalar snapshots and reuses overlapping snapshots by object identity. Its optional markSnapshotsReady callback splits each renderer call into conversion/indexing and the subsequent view.replace interval. Both are included in the primary renderer time. No snapshots were built for the unvisited part of the million-row model.

metadata.measurements: Desktop Chromium, fresh browser per run, clocks begin at local data creation or trusted button handler. Mount/seek/update clocks end at visible Element Timing status marker. Complete visits also verify a visible tile by hit test.
metadata.windowTimings: On the final-row jump, seekBeforeWindowMs ends at the first destination window commit. seekWindowMs covers that commit including slicing and verification. seekRendererMs covers only the synchronous band replacement inside that commit.
metadata.model: One object per record (id, group, score). Full mode mounts one component and visible element per record in 4096-cell bands; native React, Solid and Svelte use a framework root per band. Planned Saba adds two binding comments. Every implementation receives the same immutable per-band record snapshots. Windowed grids have 8 columns and 16 visible rows. Virtual moves on each scroll with two extra rows per side. Buffered replenishes to eight extra rows when three remain.
metadata.checkpoints: DOM count and last-cell layout confirmed for full chunks. Marker presentation sampled every >=32768 cells and at successful completion. Peak is sampled RSS of the isolated browser’s renderer processes, including baseline.

directions: Run the stockTask command from the checkout to build the production bundles. Set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH if Playwright is installed outside the project.
Make a temporary replay directory. Save replay.driver as ceiling.cjs and replay.previousSlotsBundle as previous-slots.mjs there.

From renderer-grid-slot-keys.json save reproduction.sources entries build.cjs, scale-react-slots.jsx and pool.mjs using their source fields into the same directory. Run node <directory>/build.cjs from this checkout to produce react-slots.mjs.

From renderer-grid-speed-references.json save reproduction.sources[recycled-cells.mjs].source as direct.mjs. Copy metadata.armManifest into arms.json and substitute your temporary directory for the recorded one.
Run node <directory>/ceiling.cjs <directory>/arms.json 8 <directory>/results.json from this checkout. Compare metadata.hashes for the controls before interpreting differences.
